summary: Materials research is paused this week, so only the industrials and tech scouts were ranked. The themes were 2027 data-center power and rack-integration backlogs being valued at compressed multiples (GNRC, RRX, FLEX, SANM), a de-rated fiber/BEAD build (DY), the LTL freight inflection (SAIA) and AI packaging/photonics (ONTO, GFS, SMTC). The picks for a screen are GNRC (industrials, 26): consensus 2027 EPS +34% and revenue +32%, estimates up sharply since Q2 while the stock sits 24% below its high at ~17x 2027. FLEX (tech, 25) has a third-party $37.5B Axiom mark, EPS +43%/+50%, and spin and investor-day catalysts within six months. Both lean on data-center power, so they overlap VST and each other. DY (25, the cheapest at ~13x FY28) was the close alternative but lost on the one-per-sector rule, and SARO passed the defense check (military 17.8% of revenue) but has slower growth.

ideas.name: Generac Holdings Inc.
ideas.thesis: Data-center generators turn Generac from a residential-standby cyclical into a growth story: about $1.35B of its ~$1.6B data-center backlog ships in 2027, against about $450M of data-center revenue in 2026. A second hyperscale agreement, which management expects to be at least as large as the first, is not yet in backlog. Consensus now has revenue +32% and EPS +34% in 2027, yet the stock trades at ~17x 2027 EPS.
ideas.why_now: Q2 2026 (Jul 29): sales +11%, about $1B of new data-center orders in ~90 days, and the C&I and margin guides were raised. Estimates have moved up a lot since then: FY26 EPS went from ~$8.43 before Q2 to $9.69, and FY27 from ~$10.11 to $12.97. The stock is 24% below its high at $224.6, so the multiple has compressed while the numbers rose.

catalysts.date: 2026-10 (late; not yet announced, Q3 2025 was reported Oct 29)
catalysts.event: Q3 2026 results: data-center conversion, backlog, 2027 framing
Final 2027-28 volume terms for the second hyperscale agreement, adding to backlog (management timing, not dated)
FY2027 guidance with Q4 results; capacity tripling for large-MW gensets/packaging

key_risks: Execution risk while tripling large-MW generator and packaging capacity; mix could dilute margins
Hyperscaler capex digestion or order push-outs; the second-hyperscaler terms are not yet final
Residential standby still weak (-2% in Q2) and weather-dependent
2026 margins are flattered by tariff refunds (~150bp)
Thematic overlap with the VST holding and the VRT/GEV/BE watchlist names (data-center power)
ideas.fact_check: Verified: Q2 2026 sales $1.17B (+11%), data-center backlog ~$1.6B, ~$250M shipping 2H26 and ~$1.35B in 2027, nearly $700M of 2027 volume committed under the first hyperscale deal, second hyperscale agreement signed Jun 24 and excluded from backlog, ~$450M of 2026 data-center revenue (Generac IR, Nasdaq call highlights). Corrected the scout's consensus upward: FY26 EPS $9.69 (+53%) and FY27 $12.97 (+34%) on revenue $4.93B/$6.50B (+17%/+32%), 19 analysts, updated 2026-10-08 (scout had $8.98-9.20 and $10.1-11.5). Forward P/E checked: 23.2x FY26, 17.3x FY27 at $224.59. Average target $287.78. Q3 date not yet announced. No defense exposure.
sources: Nasdaq, Generac Q2 earnings call highlights: https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/generac-q2-earnings-call-highlights

ideas.name: Flex Ltd.
ideas.thesis: Flex is spinning off Axiom, its cloud and power infrastructure business, which is guided to grow 65-75% in FY27. On Oct 5 a $2.0B convertible preferred from General Catalyst and Koch valued Axiom at a $37.5B initial EV, a third-party mark well ahead of the spin. Consensus EPS grows +43% in FY27 and +50% in FY28, and the stock is ~29% below its June high at ~17x FY28 EPS.
ideas.why_now: The Axiom preferred (8-K, 2026-10-05) gives a hard SOTP anchor. The Form 10 is filed (AXM) and the spin is targeted for Q1 CY2027. FY27 guidance was raised on Jul 29, consensus EPS is above the guide midpoint, and the next three catalysts (Oct 28 print, Nov 10 investor day, spin) all fall within six months.

catalysts.event: Q2 FY27 results (guide revenue $7.95-8.25B, adj EPS $1.00-1.07)
Investor day: first long-term targets for Axiom and RemainCo
Axiom preferred closing (HSR) and EPC Power acquisition close
Axiom spin completes (Q1 CY2027); AXM starts trading

key_risks: The preferred is senior to Axiom common: a 10% cash dividend pre-spin, then 6% cash/7% PIK, plus a redemption premium if the spin slips past 2027-12-31 (from a secondary source, not checked against the filing). The $37.5B EV overstates what accrues to FLEX holders
FY28 consensus straddles the spin, so a RemainCo-only EPS will be much lower. The screen needs a sum-of-the-parts view, not a single P/E
AI data-center capex slowdown hits the CPI/Axiom ramp, which is concentrated in a few hyperscalers
Correlated with NVDA/AVGO/GOOGL/AMZN capex and with the VST/power theme; JBL is a watchlist EMS peer
6-month +76%: the stock has already partly re-rated
ideas.fact_check: Verified: the Oct 5 8-K describes $2.0B of Axiom Series A convertible preferred sold to General Catalyst/Koch-led investors at a $37.5B initial EV, proceeds help fund EPC Power, and the spin is targeted for Q1 CY2027. Consensus (S&P via stockanalysis, updated 2026-09-28): FY27 revenue $34.62B (+24%) and EPS $4.71 (+43%); FY28 $44.98B (+30%) and EPS $7.06 (+50%); average target $160.5 from 11 analysts. Forward P/E checked at $117.84: 25.0x FY27, 16.7x FY28. The dividend and redemption-premium terms come from a secondary source and were not checked against the filing. Twelve Data statistics (EV, share count) are plan-gated, so the scout's ~$9B RemainCo EV was not independently recomputed. No defense revenue line is visible in the sources reviewed; not checked further.
sources: Finviz, Flex Q1 FY27 beat and raise, 2026-07-29: https://finviz.com/news/374258/flex-beats-first-quarter-expectations-and-raises-full-year-outlook-despite-share-decline

ideas.name: Dycom Industries, Inc.
ideas.thesis: Record $12.2B backlog (+53%) and +46% revenue growth (+17% organic), but the stock is down 52% from its May high on one soft Q3 guide and a $150M wireless deferral. BEAD construction and hyperscaler long-haul fiber ramp in CY2027, while the stock trades at ~13x FY28 EPS.
ideas.why_now: Q2 FY27 (Aug 26) beat ($5.29 adj EPS vs $4.68) and FY revenue guidance was raised. The stock fell ~22% on the Q3 EPS guide and a trimmed Communications outlook and now sits ~4% above its 52-week low.

catalysts.event: Q3 FY27 results (guide revenue $1.90-1.98B, adj EBITDA $281-302M)
FY28 guidance with Q4 FY27 results

key_risks: Telecom customer concentration and timing slips (the $150M wireless deferral)
BEAD rule and funding changes
AI capex digestion hits long-haul/data-center fiber
Building Systems integration; estimates drifted down after August
ideas.fact_check: Verified: Q2 FY27 revenue $2.006B (+45.6%, +16.7% organic), backlog $12.242B (+53.2%), adj EBITDA 15.7%, adj EPS $5.29; FY27 revenue outlook raised to $7.48-7.66B, with Building Systems up and Communications down to $5.90-6.01B. Q3 guide is revenue $1.90-1.98B. Consensus (stockanalysis, 2026-10-09): FY27 EPS $17.05 (+42%), FY28 $20.78 (+22%); the scout's Zacks FY28 figure was $20.01. Average target $520.91 (11 analysts) vs the scout's ~$445. Forward P/E at $273.21: 16.0x FY27, 13.1x FY28. Strong case, but the sector cap allows one industrials pick and GNRC scores higher with rising revisions.

ideas.name: StandardAero, Inc.
ideas.thesis: Largest independent engine MRO shop. LEAP/CFM56 programs turned profitable and FY26 guidance was raised, yet the stock is at its 52-week low at ~12x 2027 EPS as the commercial LEAP shop-visit wave builds.
ideas.why_now: Q2 2026 (Aug 6): record 14.4% EBITDA margin, adj EPS +24%, FY26 guide raised; the stock is still ~41% off its high on sponsor overhang (Carlyle/GIC ~40%).
key_risks: Sponsor overhang (Carlyle/GIC ~40%)
Air-traffic softness or shop-visit deferrals on high jet fuel
OEM-licence and customer concentration (top four OEM customers ~36% of 2025 revenue)
Military end-users 17.8% of revenue; leverage 2.6x
ideas.fact_check: Defense check (FY2025 10-K, filed 2026-02-26): 'Services to our military end-users accounted for $1,081.0 million, or 17.8%, of our revenue' in 2025 (19.0% in 2024). Part of that is directly or indirectly with the U.S. military. Military is a minority segment, not the main customer, so SARO is kept. Consensus (stockanalysis, 2026-10-09): FY26 EPS $1.53, FY27 $1.76 (+15%), revenue +6%/+9%; average target $34.03. Forward P/E at $20.37: 13.3x FY26, 11.6x FY27. Cheap, but growth is mid-teens and there is no near-dated catalyst beyond Q3.

ideas.name: Onto Innovation Inc.
ideas.thesis: Process control and lithography for advanced packaging (CoWoS, HBM, panel): backlog above $1B and a >$200M OSAT order delivering in 2027. EPS +44% in 2027 at ~25x.
ideas.why_now: Q2 beat on every line, the H2/H1 growth guide was raised to >=25%, and Q3 is guided to $380-400M / EPS $2.18-2.38, well above the consensus at the time. The stock is 24% below its June high.
key_risks: Lumpy orders concentrated in TSMC/OSAT CoWoS and HBM
High beta to AI-capex sentiment
China export controls
Correlated with NVDA/AVGO holdings and the AMAT/LRCX/FORM watchlist
ideas.fact_check: Verified: Q3 guide revenue $380-400M (consensus was ~$352M), non-GAAP EPS $2.18-2.38, issued 2026-08-06; Q2 revenue $343.1M. Consensus (stockanalysis, 2026-10-02): 2026 revenue $1.44B (+43%), EPS $8.11 (+64%); 2027 $1.88B (+31%), EPS $11.70 (+44%); 12 analysts, target $387.5. Forward P/E at $295.37: 36.4x 2026, 25.2x 2027. Strong, but less diversifying than FLEX and with more downside beta.

ideas.name: Saia Inc.
ideas.thesis: LTL carrier with the most operating leverage to a freight recovery: tonnage is up high single digits and contract renewals are +10.7%, yet the stock is -16% over 6 months on a one-quarter margin guide.
ideas.why_now: Q3 results on Oct 29 (confirmed). Monthly volumes were above 2025 in July and August.

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 results before the open (confirmed by company, 2026-09-29)

key_risks: Freight recovery stalls (ISM rolling over from 55.6 to 54.5)
Wage and fuel inflation
Pricing competition from FDXF
Still ~30x 2026 EPS with no valuation cushion
ideas.fact_check: Verified: Q3 date Oct 29, 2026 (company release). Consensus (stockanalysis, 2026-10-08): FY26 revenue $3.64B (+12%), EPS $11.37 (+25%), not the scout's $11.62; average target $423.67. The FY27 figure ($14.71) could not be confirmed (paywalled). Forward P/E at $338.08: 29.7x FY26. Revisions were up modestly (~$10.61 to $11.37) while the price fell, but the multiple is not cheap for ~25% growth.

ideas.name: GlobalFoundries Inc.
ideas.thesis: Specialty foundry whose silicon photonics/data-center business grew 62% and is targeted to double in 2026. The stock has halved from its May high to 18x 2027 EPS with $1.6B net cash.
ideas.why_now: The selloff erased the photonics re-rating while 2027 EPS consensus is +34% and the CHIPS photonics LOI ($300M) was signed.
key_risks: Mobile (~36-39% of revenue) weak on memory-driven handset costs
Chinese mature-node overcapacity
Mubadala selling overhang
Photonics still small
ideas.fact_check: Consensus verified (stockanalysis, 2026-10-09): 2026 revenue $7.3B (+7.6%), EPS $1.96 (+14%); next year $8.22B (+12.5%), EPS $2.63 (+34%); target $74.68 (23 analysts). Forward P/E at $47.67: 24.3x 2026, 18.1x 2027. Defense check: the DoD trusted-foundry contract has a $3.1B ceiling over 10 years (~$310M/yr maximum, under 5% of ~$6.8B 2025 revenue), and A&D wafers sit inside Home & Industrial IoT (2025 mix: smart mobile ~39%, auto ~21%, IoT ~18%). The 10-K's exact government share was not found. Defense is not the main customer, so GFS is kept. Revenue growth is only high-single to low-double digit.
sources: S&P Global Mobility, GFS FY2025 revenue: https://autotechinsight.spglobal.com/news/5286634/globalfoundries-reports-fy2025-revenue-at-680-billion-up-1-yoy

ideas.name: Regal Rexnord Corporation
ideas.thesis: Automation & motion is growing mid-teens, and ~$735M of E-Pod data-center power orders (20%+ margin target) start shipping in early 2027. The stock is ~15.5x 2026 EPS after a 34% drawdown.
ideas.why_now: Q2 beat on EPS but missed revenue by ~$20M; the stock fell 13-16%. Q3 results are Nov 3.
key_risks: ~3x leverage
E-Pod execution on a new turnkey product
Residential HVAC/pool weakness
Tariff refunds in 2026 EPS ($0.57)
ideas.fact_check: Verified: $735M of E-Pod orders booked in Q4 2025, shipments from early 2027, 20%+ margin target; Q2 2026 daily orders +8.8% (+8.1% ex data center), AMC organic +15.6%, 2026 EPS guide narrowed to $10.35-10.85 (midpoint $10.60) including $0.57 of tariff refunds. Forward P/E at $164.75: 15.5x the 2026 midpoint. The 2027 consensus (~$13.6) rests on only 2-3 analysts and was not confirmed. The scout's CEO name was not verified (Louis Pinkham was CEO on the Q4 2025 call). Estimates are flat to slightly down.

ideas.name: Sanmina Corporation
ideas.thesis: The ZT Systems acquisition made Sanmina a hyperscale rack integrator: FY26 revenue is guided +74% and management targets >$16B in FY27, at 15.6x FY27 EPS.
ideas.why_now: The FY27 outlook comes with Q4 FY26 results in early November; the stock is 25% below its June high.

catalysts.event: Q4 FY26 results and first FY27 outlook

key_risks: Concentration in AMD-based racks and a few hyperscalers
Thin EMS margins and working-capital swings
Only 4 covering analysts; stale consensus
Overlaps FLEX (pick) and JBL (watchlist)
ideas.fact_check: Verified: Q3 FY26 revenue $3.46B (+69.7%), ZT $1.1B, EPS $3.31; FY26 guide raised to $14.0-14.3B and EPS $11.90-12.20; management reiterated FY27 >$16B (call summaries; the exact wording was not confirmed from a transcript). Consensus is stale (2026-07-28, 4 analysts): FY27 EPS $13.92 (+15%). Forward P/E at $217.30: 18.0x FY26, 15.6x FY27. Defense check: the FY2025 10-K describes SCI Technology serving U.S. government agencies and defense primes, but gives no defense percentage. Defense sits inside the combined Industrial/Medical/Defense & Aerospace/Automotive bucket (~62% of FY25 sales before ZT), and Cloud & AI infrastructure is now 62% of revenue. Defense is not the main customer. The largest customer is 10.1% of sales. Not picked because FLEX is the stronger EMS/AI-infrastructure case.

ideas.name: Semtech Corporation
ideas.thesis: The data-center interconnect business (ACC, LPO) is inflecting: Q3 FY27 is guided to $410M and $1.05 EPS, and consensus EPS is +103% in FY27 and +68% in FY28.
ideas.why_now: The Q2 FY27 beat and Q3 guide step-up (Aug 25). But the stock is +120% over 6 months and 5% below its high.
key_risks: ~54x FY27 / 32x FY28 after a +164% year
Competition from Credo AECs
Program concentration
No diversification vs NVDA/AVGO and CRDO/ALAB/LITE/AAOI
ideas.fact_check: Consensus verified (stockanalysis, 2026-10-09): FY27 revenue $1.49B (+42%), EPS $3.48 (+103%); FY28 $1.93B (+30%), EPS $5.86 (+68%); target $214.64. Forward P/E at ~$187: 53.7x FY27, 31.9x FY28. Growth is real, but price momentum rather than lag describes the stock, and it adds no diversification.
